clips.title: The story
paras: In the Den, Rwag teaches the first steps of a rogue's craft. The orc trains newly arrived orcs and trolls in stealth, subterfuge, and dirty fighting in Durotar's Valley of Trials, under the Horde's watch.

Deep in the Den, Rwag trains fledgling rogues, cutpurses, and thieves before they venture beyond the cave into Durotar. The new Horde champions martial honor and battlefield valor, but Rwag knows subtlety, poisons, and a well-placed dagger remain tools for survival in the unforgiving desert. He keeps watch over business in the Valley and distrusts the dark practitioners sheltering in the cave, especially the warlock Nartok.
